name: Dwarf

traits.description: Increase maximum hit points by 1 for each character level.
Advantage on saving throws against poison effects and 50 percent resistance to poison damage.
While in contact with stone, activate 60-foot Tremorsense for 10 minutes as a Bonus Action. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

reviewNotes: Darkvision reduced from 120 to 60 feet; underground Dwarf Ancestry distribution remains open. Walking Speed reduced to 25 feet in the approved comparative Species review.
The maximum-HP rule's application to NPCs or monster Hit Dice remains unresolved.
